bounds: AI_CATALOGUE_DEVELOPMENT: exactly "1" to trust development key lines; any other value trusts none
adapter_type: 1 to 64 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
age_days: whole days from tested_at to the day asked about, less than RESULT_ACTIVE_MONTHS months
allowed_hosts: each a-z, 0-9, `.` or `-`
amount: a finite number, 0 or more
as_of: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
at: a real instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or a real day YYYY-MM-DD
auth_style: `bearer`, `header:<1 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens>`, `binding` or `none`
base_url: https, no white space
basis: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
by_part: each key a part of the payload; low and high finite, 0 or more, low no more than high
bytes: the body's length in UTF-8 bytes
cache_read: a finite number, 0 or more
cache_write: a finite number, 0 or more
characterization: present when the lifecycle is listed or watch
checks: P7 never met when the developer's jurisdiction is barred by the payload's policy
confirmed: true exactly when total is above 0 and reported is 0
confirmed_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
developer: name text of at most 200 characters; jurisdiction 1 to 16 letters, digits or hyphens, or OPEN
display_name: text, not blank, at most 60 characters
doc: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
effective_from: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effective_to: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effort_classes: low and medium each one of effort_set's values; only when there are values
effort_set: values distinct lowercase words of at most 16 letters; default one of them, none when there are none
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; CH4's REPORTED, with its reviewer
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; REPRODUCED names its run_ref
gate: each key a part of the payload
grade: REPRODUCED when tested_by civicsmith, else REPORTED
groups: k and n whole, k no more than n
host: the id of one of the payload's providers; a pin when its kind is aggregator or gateway, else none
input: a finite number, 0 or more
key_shapes: each a regular expression of 1 to 400 characters
kind: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
left_out: whole number, 0 or more
limits: each value a finite number, 0 or more
limits: none unless the verdict is passes_with_limits, then at least one
max_bytes: INDEX_MAX_BYTES for the index, CATALOGUE_MAX_BYTES for a payload
method: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
model: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
only: at least one, each a provider of the payload
output: a finite number, 0 or more
page: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters; with quote, required on a check answer
parts: each key a part of the payload
plan_ids: at least one, distinct, each a plan of the payload whose provider is the host
price_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
profile: id a profile of the payload of the same adapter_type; min_version whole, 1 to that profile's version
provider: the id of one of the payload's providers
quirks: each a-z or `_`
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters; with page, required on a check answer
results: whole numbers; total is reproduced plus reported
run_ref: at most 200 characters, not blank
samples: whole number, 0 or more
section: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
served_ids: at least one, each text of at most 200 characters
sha256: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the body's UTF-8 bytes
shutdown_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
source: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters
subject_id: an entry's form of id, never an entry's id
subject_id: an entry's or a tested AI's id
team_name: only a team's row, with its consent_ref; text of at most 120 characters
terms_pending: ordered by effective_from, each after the day asked about
terms_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the restrictions and binding terms
tested_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
tier: at most 64 characters, not blank
unit: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
url: CATALOGUE_ADDRESS, or a path beneath it
version: as text, not blank, at most 64 characters
version: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
version: whole number, 1 or more
warning_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the warning's text

adapter_type: 1 to 64 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
age_days: whole days from tested_at to the day asked about, less than RESULT_ACTIVE_MONTHS months
allowed_hosts: each a-z, 0-9, `.` or `-`
amount: a finite number, 0 or more
as_of: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
at: a real instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or a real day YYYY-MM-DD
auth_style: `bearer`, `header:<1 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens>`, `binding` or `none`
base_url: https, no white space
basis: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
by_part: each key a part of the payload; low and high finite, 0 or more, low no more than high
bytes: the body's length in UTF-8 bytes
cache_read: a finite number, 0 or more
cache_write: a finite number, 0 or more
characterization: present when the lifecycle is listed or watch
checks: P7 never met when the developer's jurisdiction is barred by the payload's policy
confirmed: true exactly when total is above 0 and reported is 0
confirmed_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
developer: name text of at most 200 characters; jurisdiction 1 to 16 letters, digits or hyphens, or OPEN
display_name: text, not blank, at most 60 characters
doc: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
effective_from: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effective_to: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effort_classes: low and medium each one of effort_set's values; only when there are values
effort_set: values distinct lowercase words of at most 16 letters; default one of them, none when there are none
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; CH4's REPORTED, with its reviewer
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; REPRODUCED names its run_ref
gate: each key a part of the payload
grade: REPRODUCED when tested_by civicsmith, else REPORTED
groups: k and n whole, k no more than n
host: the id of one of the payload's providers; a pin when its kind is aggregator or gateway, else none
input: a finite number, 0 or more
key_shapes: each a regular expression of 1 to 400 characters
kind: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
left_out: whole number, 0 or more
limits: each value a finite number, 0 or more
limits: none unless the verdict is passes_with_limits, then at least one
max_bytes: INDEX_MAX_BYTES for the index, CATALOGUE_MAX_BYTES for a payload
method: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
model: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
only: at least one, each a provider of the payload
output: a finite number, 0 or more
page: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters; with quote, required on a check answer
parts: each key a part of the payload
plan_ids: at least one, distinct, each a plan of the payload whose provider is the host
price_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
profile: id a profile of the payload of the same adapter_type; min_version whole, 1 to that profile's version
provider: the id of one of the payload's providers
quirks: each a-z or `_`
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters; with page, required on a check answer
results: whole numbers; total is reproduced plus reported
run_ref: at most 200 characters, not blank
samples: whole number, 0 or more
section: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
served_ids: at least one, each text of at most 200 characters
sha256: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the body's UTF-8 bytes
shutdown_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
source: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters
subject_id: an entry's form of id, never an entry's id
subject_id: an entry's or a tested AI's id
team_name: only a team's row, with its consent_ref; text of at most 120 characters
terms_pending: ordered by effective_from, each after the day asked about
terms_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the restrictions and binding terms
tested_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
tier: at most 64 characters, not blank
unit: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
url: CATALOGUE_ADDRESS, or a path beneath it
version: as text, not blank, at most 64 characters
version: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
version: whole number, 1 or more
warning_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the warning's text
zero_retention: true when the entry's zero_retention is true

characterization: present when the lifecycle is listed or watch
checks: P7 never met when the developer's jurisdiction is barred by the payload's policy

connection_ways: at least one, distinct
date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD

display_name: text, not blank, at most 60 characters
doc: text, not blank, at most 400 characters

effective_to: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effort_classes: low and medium each one of effort_set's values; only when there are values
effort_set: values distinct lowercase words of at most 16 letters; default one of them, none when there are none
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; CH4's REPORTED, with its reviewer

gate: each key a part of the payload

groups: k and n whole, k no more than n
guidance_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
host: the id of one of the payload's providers; a pin when its kind is aggregator or gateway, else none
input: a finite number, 0 or more
key_shapes: each a regular expression of 1 to 400 characters
kind: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
left_out: whole number, 0 or more
limits: each value a finite number, 0 or more
limits: none unless the verdict is passes_with_limits, then at least one
means_allowed: at least one, distinct; `none` alone and only for credential kind none; gateway only for api_key; issued only for signin_token
method: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
model: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
name: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
only: at least one, each a provider of the payload
output: a finite number, 0 or more
page: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters; with quote, required on a check answer
parts: each key a part of the payload
plan_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
plan_ids: at least one, distinct, each a plan of the payload whose provider is the host
price_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
profile: id a profile of the payload of the same adapter_type; min_version whole, 1 to that profile's version
provider: the id of one of the payload's providers
quirks: each a-z or `_`
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters; with page, required on a check answer
results: whole numbers; total is reproduced plus reported
run_ref: at most 200 characters, not blank
runtimes: at least one, distinct
samples: whole number, 0 or more
section: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
served_ids: at least one, each text of at most 200 characters
shutdown_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
source: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters
steps: at least one; a url is https
subject_id: an entry's form of id, never an entry's id
subject_id: an entry's or a tested AI's id
team_name: only a team's row, with its consent_ref; text of at most 120 characters
tested_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
tier: at most 64 characters, not blank
token_bounds: only for credential kind signin_token; whole numbers, 1 or more, min_length no more than max_length
unit: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
version: as text, not blank, at most 64 characters
version: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
version: whole number, 1 or more
warning_id: a warning of the payload, required when free_tier_trains is true
zero_retention: true when the entry's zero_retention is true

bounds: AI_CATALOGUE_DEVELOPMENT: exactly "1" to trust development key lines; any other value trusts none
adapter_type: 1 to 64 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
age_days: whole days from tested_at to the day asked about, less than RESULT_ACTIVE_MONTHS months
allowed_hosts: each a-z, 0-9, `.` or `-`
amount: a finite number, 0 or more
as_of: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
at: a real instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or a real day YYYY-MM-DD
auth_style: `bearer`, `header:<1 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens>`, `binding` or `none`
base_url: https, no white space
basis: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
by_part: each key a part of the payload; low and high finite, 0 or more, low no more than high
bytes: the body's length in UTF-8 bytes
cache_read: a finite number, 0 or more
cache_write: a finite number, 0 or more
characterization: present when the lifecycle is listed or watch
checks: P7 never met when the developer's jurisdiction is barred by the payload's policy
confirmed: true exactly when total is above 0 and reported is 0
confirmed_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
developer: name text of at most 200 characters; jurisdiction 1 to 16 letters, digits or hyphens, or OPEN
display_name: text, not blank, at most 60 characters
doc: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
effective_from: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effective_to: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
effort_classes: low and medium each one of effort_set's values; only when there are values
effort_set: values distinct lowercase words of at most 16 letters; default one of them, none when there are none
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; CH4's REPORTED, with its reviewer
ev: graded REPRODUCED or REPORTED; REPRODUCED names its run_ref
gate: each key a part of the payload
grade: REPRODUCED when tested_by civicsmith, else REPORTED
groups: k and n whole, k no more than n
host: the id of one of the payload's providers; a pin when its kind is aggregator or gateway, else none
input: a finite number, 0 or more
key_shapes: each a regular expression of 1 to 400 characters
kind: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
left_out: whole number, 0 or more
limits: each value a finite number, 0 or more
limits: none unless the verdict is passes_with_limits, then at least one
max_bytes: INDEX_MAX_BYTES for the index, CATALOGUE_MAX_BYTES for a payload
method: text, not blank, at most 400 characters
model: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
only: at least one, each a provider of the payload
output: a finite number, 0 or more
page: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters; with quote, required on a check answer
parts: each key a part of the payload
plan_ids: at least one, distinct, each a plan of the payload whose provider is the host
price_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
profile: id a profile of the payload of the same adapter_type; min_version whole, 1 to that profile's version
provider: the id of one of the payload's providers
quirks: each a-z or `_`
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters
quote: text, not blank, at most 8000 characters; with page, required on a check answer
results: whole numbers; total is reproduced plus reported
run_ref: at most 200 characters, not blank
samples: whole number, 0 or more
section: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
served_ids: at least one, each text of at most 200 characters
sha256: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the body's UTF-8 bytes
shutdown_date: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
source: text, not blank, at most 2000 characters
subject_id: an entry's form of id, never an entry's id
subject_id: an entry's or a tested AI's id
team_name: only a team's row, with its consent_ref; text of at most 120 characters
terms_pending: ordered by effective_from, each after the day asked about
terms_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the restrictions and binding terms
tested_at: a real calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD
tier: at most 64 characters, not blank
unit: text, not blank, at most 64 characters
url: CATALOGUE_ADDRESS, or a path beneath it
version: as text, not blank, at most 64 characters
version: text, not blank, at most 200 characters
version: whole number, 1 or more
warning_version: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of the warning's text
zero_retention: true when the entry's zero_retention is true
